v4.9.075 - the drawing stays in front of you (#356)

#356 "The moment you draw it disappears." It never disappeared. In 3x2 you press
     DRAW, the big view opens, you draw, you close it - and closing put the card
     back to the MAIN frame. The drawing was safe in the version the whole time;
     it just was not on the screen any more, which to the person holding the iPad
     is the same thing.

     One line in closeFullscreen, written on purpose a long time ago, and it had
     always disagreed with the camera: photograph a card in 3x2 and the app
     deliberately switches the card to the new version so the picture stays
     visible. Two rules, opposite answers, and which one won depended on whether
     the big view happened to be involved.

     Now, in 3x2 only, the card keeps showing the version you were just on. The
     strip views are unchanged - they always kept it - and 4-up and the overview
     are unchanged too.

     Not the sync. Not this week's work. It predates all of it.

THE SIMULATOR CAN NOW HOLD A PENCIL, AND CAN SEE THE SCREEN

Every guess I made about this was a guess, because nothing in the simulator could
draw. There is now a door that opens the drawing view the way the DRAW button
does, moves a finger across the real canvas, and asks the project what it holds.

And - this is the part that mattered - a door that asks what the CARD IS SHOWING.
Every test written so far asked the project and was blind to the screen. That is
the same blindness that let the photo, the setups and the shooting order go
missing in front of Roman for two days while thirteen tests said green.

Three new tests: a stroke survives its own push and pull; a stroke survives the
other device's work arriving; and the card still shows the version you drew on.
The first two passed BEFORE this change, which is how the real cause was found.
